findings.issue: The debounced search timer survives SPA navigation; if the user types and clicks a card within 150 ms, applyFilters(true) runs history.replaceState with the home URL, replacing the new page's history entry (URL shows /?q=… while the Pokémon page is displayed).
findings.suggestion: Pass ctx.isCurrent() into the handlers (or clear the timer in a cleanup hook) and bail out of applyFilters when the page is no longer current.

findings.issue: result.ready rejections are silently swallowed, and app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:195 fires show() with void, so a move-fetch failure leaves an empty, permanently aria-busy Moves section and an unhandled rejection on select changes.
findings.suggestion: Catch inside show() and render a retry/error message in the moves body instead of relying on the caller to swallow.

findings.issue: Only non-NotFound rejections evict the cached promise, so a resource that returned 404 once is dead for the whole session even though the API is meant to be treated as live data.
findings.suggestion: Evict NotFoundError rejections too (or add a short TTL for negative results).

findings.issue: If a stored species fails to load, the empty branch renders '<n> of 6' from readTeam().length alongside 'Your team is empty', with no way to remove the stale entries.
findings.suggestion: Drop failed members from storage when loadMember returns null, or render a 'could not load' row with its own remove button.

findings.issue: Species→default-variety resolution is duplicated verbatim in app/src/pages/team.ts:26.
findings.suggestion: Add a defaultPokemon(species) helper next to the Species interface in api.ts and use it in both pages.

findings.issue: Local helper typeNames(types: Type[]) shadows the imported api.ts:113 typeNames(names: Iterable<string>) with different semantics; the same label map is also built inline in types.ts:25 and home.ts.
findings.suggestion: Rename the local one (e.g. typeLabelMap) or move a single canonical helper into api.ts.

findings.issue: The 'numeric' flag on COLUMNS is declared and populated but never read; compareValues uses typeof instead.
findings.suggestion: Either use the flag in compareValues or delete it.

findings.issue: history.scrollRestoration = 'manual' combined with render(false) on popstate means back/forward never restore scroll position.
findings.suggestion: Either leave scroll restoration to the browser, or snapshot/restore scrollY per history entry alongside the navigation token.

findings.issue: The fragment(...) block inside results.replaceChildren is mis-indented, making the update() body harder to scan than the rest of the file.
findings.suggestion: Re-indent the block (or hoist it into a small pagination helper).

summary: A well-layered, fully typed vanilla TS + Vite app on current toolchain (Vite 8.3.5, TypeScript 7), with clean routing, safe DOM construction and a justified custom static server; the team-builder feature was folded in following the existing conventions exactly. The blocking issue is a debounce timer on the home page that can rewrite the URL after the user has navigated away, plus swallowed async errors in the Moves section. I'd merge after that small round of fixes.
